description: Header file defining a dummy implementation of the Ambiorix class within the nbapi namespace, including method declarations for setting and reading parameters, managing instances, and time setting.

classes.name: AmbiorixDummy
classes.description: Dummy version of Ambiorix class implementing various set, read, and instance management methods.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Overloaded methods to set parameters of various types for a given relative path and parameter name.

methods.name: read_param
methods.description: Overloaded methods to read parameters of various types from a given object path and parameter name.

methods.name: add_instance
methods.description: Adds a new instance at the specified relative path.

methods.name: remove_instance
methods.description: Removes an instance at the specified relative path and index.

methods.name: get_instance_index
methods.description: Retrieves the index of a specific instance based on path and key.

methods.name: get_datamodel_time_format
methods.description: Returns the time format used in the data model.

methods.name: remove_all_instances
methods.description: Removes all instances at the specified relative path.

methods.name: add_optional_subobject
methods.description: Adds an optional subobject to a specified object path.

methods.name: remove_optional_subobject
methods.description: Removes an optional subobject from a specified object path.

methods.name: set_current_time
methods.description: Sets the current time for a specified object, defaulting to 'TimeStamp'.

methods.name: set_time
methods.description: Sets the time for a specified object path.
